changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE buildings RENAME COLUMN settlement_id TO history_settlement_id
ALTER TABLE buildings ADD COLUMN settlement_id TEXT CONSTRAINT fk_building_current_settlement REFERENCES settlements(settlement_id)
ALTER TABLE buildings ADD COLUMN ownership_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
ALTER TABLE building_revisions ADD COLUMN settlement_id TEXT CONSTRAINT fk_building_revision_settlement REFERENCES settlements(settlement_id)

column.name: settlement_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT history_settlement_id FROM buildings WHERE buildings.building_id = building_revisions.building_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE building_revisions ADD COLUMN ownership_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
